{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Albania|Cuisine of Albania]]

Several different dishes are called "'''mixed vegetables'''"; they all consist primarily of different kinds of [[Cookbook:Vegetables|vegetables]] cut into pieces and mixed together, then either served as-is or else cooked, typically by [[Cookbook:saute|sautéing]]. This recipe is for an [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Albania|Albanian]] mixed vegetables dish called ''Turli perimesh''.

==Ingredients==
*2 [[Cookbook:Pound|lbs]] of various vegetables ([[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|peppers]], [[Cookbook:Eggplant|eggplant]], [[Cookbook:Okra|okra]], [[Cookbook:Zucchini|zucchini]], [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]], etc.)
*½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Oil|oil]], divided
*1 cup [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]
*1 cup peeled chopped [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] chopped [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
*[[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]]

==Procedure==

# Cut off inedible tips of vegetables. Wash and slice them into 1-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] squares.
# Sauté vegetables in half the oil and remove them from the [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]].
# [[Cookbook:Saute|Sauté]] onion and tomatoes in the remaining oil, and season with parsley, salt, and pepper.
# Put everything in a [[Cookbook:Stock pot|stock pot]] with a cup of water, cover tightly, and simmer until almost all moisture has cooked away.
# Serve hot, accompanied by [[Cookbook:Steak|steak]], [[Cookbook:Meatball|meatball]]s, or any other main dish.
